Definition: Jedajah, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Two Israelites share the name Jedaiah, the son of Shimri in the line of Simeon, and the son of Harumaph who repaired the wall over against his own house in the days of Nehemiah. One stands in the genealogy, the other on the wall.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God keeps the man who builds over against his own house, and Jedaiah's wall is still standing in the record.
RelatedPeople: Jedaiah, Son of Shimri; Jedaiah, Son of Harumaph
